rules.title: Residential Rental Property Application Fee Limitation
rules.requirement: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50. The fee shall be adjusted annually by the Director of the Division of Consumer Affairs in direct proportion to the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over a 12-month period ending October 31 of the previous year, with adjustment effective January 1 of each following calendar year. An adjustment in the fee limitation shall be made only if the percent change in the Consumer Price Index for the period specified is greater than zero.

rules.key_value: $50 base limit, adjusted annually by CPI percent change if greater than zero
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental property for dwelling purposes; excludes one-family and two-family dwellings; excludes licensees of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission unless they are the landlord of the property
rules.exemptions: (1) dwelling unit located in a one-family or two-family dwelling that is offered for rent; (2) licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission, unless the licensee is the landlord of the residential rental property
rules.sanctions: Penalty of up to $500 for a first offense, up to $750 for a second offense, and up to $1,000 for each subsequent offense, enforced by summary proceedings pursuant to the Penalty Enforcement Law of 1999, P.L.1999, c.274. Amount wrongfully charged shall be remitted to the applicant or prospective tenant.
